'''R8-X4L''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that was part of the security forces of the [[Jedi Colony]] established on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. During the [[Invasion of Ossus]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] forces have sabotaged Republic communications, causing many of their security droids to go haywire and attack both sides of the conflict. The droid was eventually destroyed during fighting.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=general|Crossed Wires|Ossus}}</ref>
